title: Controlled vocabulary: data/terms.json
description: One entry per concept. The lint flags every banned variant in prose. The id of a term equals the GitHub anchor of its `term`. The glossary is generated from this file, and `cards build` generates the term, meaning and partner flashcards from it (writers do not write those card types).

term.description: the official term, capitalised as AWS documentation does

short.description: the one allowed short form, after the full term was used once in the file

banned.description: literal variants that must not appear in prose; matched without regard to case (lint L901); no parentheses and no conditions

banned_case.description: variants that are wrong only in exactly this capitalisation, for example 'availability zone'; matched case-sensitively (lint L901)

avoid.description: variants that are wrong only in a context, written as 'text (context)'; for writers and reviewers, not matched by the lint

aliases.description: plural and other forms that the glossary auto-link and the search also match

respelling.description: pronunciation help with the stressed syllable in capitals

meaning.description: plain meaning in one sentence, no numbers and no limits

collocations.description: word partners, the partner word first where possible

facts.description: facts that ground the meaning; empty in the seed
